lines.zh: 我一跳一跳地挪，肚子贴着水。
lines.en: I hop along, belly to the water.
Hind legs kick, and I leap half a block.

lines.zh: 泥被我踩出一个个圆印。
lines.en: My feet leave round prints in the mud.
I slowly climb the wet bank.

lines.zh: 鼓声一样的声音，是我的喉咙。
lines.en: A drum-like sound comes from my throat.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，水纹晃开。
lines.en: Ripples spread where I pass.
I hop into the shallows, then climb out.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤是土色的，很厚。
lines.en: My skin is earth-colored and thick.
Each hop drags water with it.

lines.zh: 我蹲在荷叶上，叶子沉了。
lines.en: I crouch on a lily pad; it sinks.
I move forward with a burp.
I circle the pond's edge.
The reeds are full of my voice.
I raise my forelegs to steady myself.
I twist to look behind.
I cross from one end of the mud pit to the other.
Crouched, my throat swelling and sinking.
I open my mouth for a low call.
An insect skims the water.
I soak my body in the water.

lines.zh: 这是我平常的声音，更大。
lines.en: This is my usual voice, only louder.
I blink, and my lids are thick.
A layer of wet mud on my back.
I wait for the next insect.
The wind wrinkles the water.
I shift to a drier spot.
My throat is swelling.
A frog answers me from far off.
I slowly tuck my legs in.
A string of bubbles rises from the mud.
I chew; my mouth is full of water.
I move only once the sun is down.
You are standing at the edge of my pond.
I am a size larger than an ordinary frog.
Your foot's sunk into my pond mud.
I swell my throat once.

lines.zh: 你靴子上的水是我的塘。
lines.en: The water on your boots came from my pond.
You stare at me, and my throat swells.
This water is mine.
Set down what you are holding.
I rarely let anyone come close.
There is mud at my mouth.

lines.zh: 我一声就能叫醒整片池塘。
lines.en: One call of mine wakes the whole pond.
Have you come to nab me?
A muffled sound squeezes out of my throat.
The water parts around me.
A pale line opens in my thick hide.
Half a step back, the mud gives.
It hurts, but I am not soft.
I press into the mud.
Blood in the water, quickly gone.
My throat swells harder.
I can take this.
Another will not drive me off.
An insect. Still alive.
Put that thing on the water.
One flick of my tongue reaches it.
Flap it once more.
I smell something rank in the water.
Do not hold it over my head.

lines.zh: 我这条舌头比你想的长。
lines.en: My tongue is longer than you think.
Let me have one bite.
Do not keep shaking your hand.
Put it on that lily pad.
I do not eat dry things.
Bring one more.
Too big to swallow.
Do not step back. I cannot reach.
Hop by hop, I close in.
This thing moves in the water.

lines.zh: 你碰到我了，水都溅起来。
lines.en: You bumped me and water flew.
I am heavy. I do not move.
Step back. The mud is slick.
My foot caught yours.
My hide is very thick.
A scrape is no matter.
I hopped aside.
My body pushes a ring across the water.
Do not stand so close.
I turn very slowly.
There are already a few in the pond.
That is what my call is for.
Wait for a rain to fall.
The water needs to be deeper.
You ask at the wrong time.
Fill my belly first.
My voice will call others.
The mud is terribly crowded.
This is a matter of season.
I sink back into the water.
Something floats on the water.

lines.zh: 舌头一弹，东西就回来了。
lines.en: One flick of my tongue, and it's back.
Not food. I spit it out.
I paw at it.
I can't drag it, so I shove it.
I press it into the mud and hide it.
Something bright on the bottom.
I bite it. Hard.
I will keep this one.
This is from my pond. Leave it.
Ripples push toward me.
I see you. Don't move again.
My legs are loaded.
Come this way.
No one stands at my pond's edge.
Do not try slipping out of my pond.
I am ready to spring.
Get up onto the bank.
My throat has swollen.
This will be very loud.
I crouch in the mud without moving.
Only my eyes show above it.
The ripples come closer.
I gauge this leap.
My tongue is coiled and ready.
Water is right at your feet.
I shift half an inch, and the mud stays silent.
The mud is soft. You are unsteady.
Wait a little while longer.
Turn your back, and I jump.
I kick off and slam you with my belly.
My tongue snaps out and hits.
A shove from my forelegs and you slip.

lines.zh: 这一下比普通蛙重一倍。
lines.en: That blow is twice an ordinary frog's.
Water splashes your face.
I butt your knee.
I drop back into the water.
One more step and my tongue hits your face.
I come down heavy, and the mud gives way.
I retreat half a block and crouch again.
The mud bulges up before I show.
A ring splashes across the water.
I'm not in sight, but my call arrives first.
I am the only one in this stretch of water.

lines.zh: 泥块从背上滑下去一片。
lines.en: Clods of mud slide off my back.
The pond's edge is quiet.
I am bigger than the other frogs.
My weight dents the mud bottom.
First I scan the water.
My hide is thick and heavy.
The water's surface has gone hot.

lines.zh: 我从岸上翻下来，摔进泥里。
lines.en: I tumble off the bank into the mud.

lines.zh: 水里是我的地方，可这太深。
lines.en: Water is my place, but this is too deep.
The blast throws mud everywhere.
An arrow sticks in my back.
This light burns my hide.
No insects in the water.
Current spreads across the water.
No water under me. Straight down.
